name: temporary-workspace-remote
summary: Typert Remote protocol between the Client and Host halves of the temporary Workspace plugin.
rationale: The browser requests opaque reservations; the Host retains sole custody of directory creation and deletion so no cleanup method accepts a caller-supplied path.

transport.resultShape: RemoteResult<T> = { ok: true, value: T } | { ok: false, error: { code, message } }

capabilitySecurity.description: reserve() mints a UUID that is the only handle accepted by adopt(), retain(), and discard(). The settings API accepts a parent path only for validated future allocation; no cleanup method accepts a caller-supplied filesystem path.
capabilitySecurity.verifiedBy: packages/plugin/tests/reservations.spec.ts verifies containment, opaque-id deletion, symlink resistance, and crash recovery.

reserve.effect: Creates a unique workspace-* child below the configured parent, writes a pending marker, and sweeps abandoned reservations first.

adopt.effect: Registers the reserved path as a Workspace, validates and attaches the created Session, moves the Workspace to the end, and clears its pending marker.

retain.effect: Clears the pending marker without attaching a Session. Used only when rollback cannot remove a Workspace registration and deleting its directory would be unsafe.

discard.effect: Removes an unadopted reservation. Idempotent: a retired or unknown id reports found: false.

describeSettings.effect: Returns the revision-fenced live parent-directory setting used by the Web settings card.

saveSettings.effect: Normalizes an absolute non-filesystem-root path, creates and permission-checks it, persists it through DSH Settings, and uses it for future reservations.

pickRoot.effect: Uses the Host-native directory picker when available. A null path is cancellation.

lifecycle.currentFlow: Every creation action reserves a new child, registers that child as its own Workspace, creates and opens one Session in it, then adopts the reservation.
lifecycle.isolation: Each invocation receives a distinct canonical cwd. Blank-session reuse remains confined to the newly created Workspace and cannot cross task boundaries.
lifecycle.durability: Adopted Workspace directories are retained because deleting them would invalidate historical Session cwd values.
lifecycle.crashWindow: A Host crash between reserve and adopt/retain/discard leaves a pending marker. A later sweep reclaims only markers older than reservationRetentionMs.
lifecycle.rollback: Registration failure discards the child. Session creation failure deregisters the Workspace and discards the child; if deregistration fails, retain preserves the directory beneath the live registration.

configuration.root: Configurable parent directory; defaults to $DSH_HOME/temporary-workspaces. The Settings namespace is temporary-workspace.
configuration.reservationRetentionMs: Grace before an unadopted reservation is treated as abandoned; defaults to 3600000 and has a 60000 floor.
